<js>
var html = String(result);
var url = String(baseUrl);
var isMl = url.indexOf('/ml') !== -1;
var su = source.getKey();
var bookPath = url.replace(su, '').replace(/^\//, '').split('/')[0];
var base = su + '/' + bookPath + '/';
if (!isMl) {
    html = String(java.ajax(base + 'ml1.html'));
}
var opts = html.match(/ml(\d+)\.html/g);
var maxPage = 1;
if (opts) {
    for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
        var p = parseInt(opts[i].match(/\d+/)[0]);
        if (p > maxPage) maxPage = p;
    }
}
var allItems = '';
for (var p = 1; p <= maxPage; p++) {
    var pageHtml = (p === 1) ? html : String(java.ajax(base + 'ml' + p + '.html'));
    var ulMatch = pageHtml.match(/<ul class="chapter-list">([\s\S]*?)<\/ul>/);
    if (ulMatch) {
        allItems += ulMatch[1];
    }
}
result = allItems;
